div.head: Stefan Reichmuth’s visit to the WIBARAB team
div.p: Professor Stefan Reichmuth from Ruhr University Bochum agreed to pay us a visit in mid-June for a presentation about his field work in Sudan during the 70s. We are very much looking forward to his reports about his experiences!
